caption:
Purify, remember, pray: the path to success

Allah tells us that whoever purifies himself, remembers his Lord's Name and prays will attain success. Today is Friday, so make time to purify your heart, remember Allah and pray with presence.

Surah Al-A'laa 87:14-15

Share this with someone getting ready for Jumu'ah today

#jumuah #fridayreminder #surahala #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
